board_title: 带红缨长枪｜前・左・右・后四视图
board_subtitle: 前／右／后沿用V5原图；新增左侧整体等比对齐，隐藏结构与红缨遮挡待验收
limitation_note: 左侧补图红缨展开较宽、根部遮挡未严格对应右视；原始生成图保留，未镜像或局部拉伸，需造型验收。

normalization.method: Single uniform whole-image scaling plus white canvas placement; no mirror, rotation or component stretching. Only blank canvas is cropped.

limitations: The generated view has a narrow blade profile and is a new image, not a mirrored V5 right image.
The tassel is broader than expected from the V5 right-side silhouette and the far-side attachment occlusion is not fully demonstrated. Exact left/right geometry correspondence is not verified.
Overall tip-to-butt height can be uniformly aligned, but individual connector heights and cloth folds are not guaranteed pixel-identical across generated views.
Original image top margin is 41px, below the requested 64px. Complete spear tip, butt and cloth terminal remain visible.
